name: Workboard Controller
description: Automatically dispatches Workboard ready cards after terminal events, notifies owners when cards start, and wakes owners on problem events.

enabled.description: Start the controller service on Gateway startup. Default true.

boardId.description: Workboard board id to watch. Default default.

subscriptionId.description: Existing Workboard notification subscription id to reuse.

target.description: Notification subscription target marker. Default workboard-controller.

pollIntervalMs.description: Notification poll interval in milliseconds. Default 15000.

batchLimit.description: Maximum Workboard notifications to process per tick. Default 50.

dispatchCooldownMs.description: Minimum delay between dispatch calls. Default 2000.

dispatchTimeoutMs.description: Gateway self-route timeout for Workboard dispatch in milliseconds. Default 60000.

gatewayBaseUrl.description: Optional Gateway HTTP base URL for /tools/invoke and the controller self-route. Default http://127.0.0.1:${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT || gateway.port || 18789}.

gatewayToolSessionKey.description: Session key passed to /tools/invoke for Workboard notification tool policy routing. Default main.

sessionKey.description: Full direct owner/routing session key. Preserve the channel-specific key exactly; do not use agent shortcuts.

tenant.description: Optional tenant match from public Workboard card metadata.

agentId.description: Optional Workboard card agent id match.

ownerRoutes.description: Channel-agnostic owner routing table. Each entry must include sessionKey and at least one of tenant, boardId, or agentId. Match priority is tenant+boardId+agentId, then boardId+agentId, then tenant+boardId or tenant+agentId, then single dimensions; equal priority uses declaration order.

startNotifyEnabled.description: Notify the owner/routing session when dispatch starts Workboard cards. Default true.

startNotifySessionKey.description: Legacy global start-notification fallback used only when ownerRoutes has no match.

wakeEnabled.description: Wake owner sessions on failed/stale/blocked events. Default true.

wakeFallbackSessionKey.description: Legacy global problem-wake fallback used only when ownerRoutes has no match.

wakeFallbackAgentId.description: Fallback agent id when an event/card has no agent. Default main.

wakeTimeoutMs.description: Problem wake embedded-agent timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000.

wakeToolsAllow.description: Optional tool allowlist for problem wake runs.

compatibleOpenClawVersions.description: Exact OpenClaw versions accepted by this compatibility seam.

allowUntestedOpenClawVersion.description: Disable exact OpenClaw version fail-fast. Default false.

archiveEnabled.description: Archive eligible done Workboard cards. Default false.

archiveDryRun.description: Report archive candidates without mutating cards. Default true.

archiveCompletedGraphAfterMs.description: Cooling period for all-done linked components before archive. Default 86400000.

archiveStandaloneAfterMs.description: Cooling period for standalone done cards before archive. Default 604800000.

archiveRequireProof.description: Require every card to have non-failed proof before archive. Default true.

archiveScanIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay between archive scans. Default 3600000.
